d: For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

d: We're looking for an independent, hands-on, and forward-thinking Head of Internal Audit to establish and lead Ziina's Internal Audit function.

As our first dedicated Internal Audit hire, you'll have the opportunity to build the function from the ground up, define its approach, and deliver independent assurance across our existing regulated operations and future regulated entities as Ziina expands.

You'll operate with significant autonomy and direct access to the Board of Directors, owning audit planning, execution, and reporting while working closely with teams across the business and maintaining the independence required of the function.

We're looking for someone who combines strong fintech audit experience with a pragmatic, technology-driven mindset. Someone who understands regulatory expectations, identifies meaningful risks, leverages data and automation, and builds effective audit practices without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

This is an opportunity to shape a modern Internal Audit function within a fast-growing fintech, with broad business exposure and meaningful influence over the Company's governance and control environment.
q: This position is subject to the prior approval of the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE). The selected candidate must satisfy all applicable regulatory eligibility, fit-and-proper, and suitability requirements. The appointment and commencement of regulated duties will be conditional upon obtaining the required CBUAE approval.
r: Build and lead the Internal Audit function from the ground up, establishing its charter, methodology, policies, procedures, and governance framework in line with CBUAE requirements and applicable professional standards.
Develop and execute a risk-based Internal Audit Plan, independently assessing the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal controls across Ziina's regulated activities.
Conduct end-to-end audits, including planning, risk assessment, control testing, evidence evaluation, reporting, and remediation follow-up, initially operating as a standalone function.

Provide independent assurance across financial, operational, regulatory, and technology risks, including payments, AML/CFT, consumer protection, safeguarding of customer funds, outsourcing, cybersecurity, and data protection.

Leverage data analytics and automation to enhance audit testing, identify anomalies, assess controls at scale, and reduce manual processes, collaborating with Engineering and Data teams where relevant.

Provide independent reporting and insights to the Board, highlighting material risks, control deficiencies, audit findings, and remediation progress through clear, objective, and actionable recommendations.
Challenge stakeholders constructively, identifying root causes and recommending practical improvements while maintaining independence from management and operational decision-making.
Oversee audit findings and remediation, establishing appropriate tracking mechanisms, monitoring management's corrective actions, and independently validating their effectiveness.
Coordinate regulatory and external assurance activities with CBUAE, external auditors, and independent reviewers on matters within the Internal Audit function's remit.
Extend audit coverage to new regulated entities, adapting the audit approach to evolving business activities, products, jurisdictions, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Continuously improve audit effectiveness, introducing scalable processes, technology-enabled testing, and proportionate governance practices that support Ziina's growth.
To succeed in this role, you likely

Have 7+ years of Internal Audit experience, including direct, hands-on experience auditing fintech companies, preferably within payments, digital financial services, or technology-driven regulated financial institutions.
Have a strong understanding of risk-based auditing, internal controls, corporate governance, and the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards.
Have experience operating within CBUAE-regulated environments or comparable financial regulatory frameworks, with the ability to understand and apply UAE regulatory requirements.
Hold a relevant professional qualification such as CIA, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent recognized certification.
Have demonstrated experience developing audit plans, executing control testing, identifying findings, and communicating results to senior leadership or Board-level stakeholders.
Are comfortable establishing and operating a function independently, taking ownership of both strategic priorities and hands-on execution.
Understand technology-driven financial services and can assess risks across operational processes, financial crime controls, IT systems, and regulatory obligations.
Bring strong analytical skills and an interest in leveraging data, technology, and automation to improve audit effectiveness.
Exercise sound professional judgment, prioritize material risks, and deliver practical recommendations without unnecessary complexity.
Communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and build effective relationships across teams while maintaining professional independence.
Thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment where ownership, adaptability, and execution are essential.
You've previously established or transformed an Internal Audit function, particularly within a fintech or high-growth regulated business.
You've personally developed automated audit tests, used SQL, Python, Power BI, or similar tools, or implemented data-driven audit methodologies.
You've introduced continuous auditing or monitoring approaches that improved risk detection, audit coverage, or operational efficiency.
You've audited payment platforms, digital financial products, AML/CFT systems, or technology infrastructure.
You've worked across multiple regulated entities or jurisdictions and successfully adapted audit frameworks to different regulatory requirements.
You're known for combining independent judgment, strong technical expertise, and a practical, solutions-oriented approach.
You've demonstrated the ability to build effective audit capabilities with lean resources, focusing on quality, meaningful risk coverage, and measurable outcomes.

d: Would you like to be part of the most international company in the world? A company operating in more than 220 countries worldwide and has been pioneering cross-border express shipping since 1969. Would you like to be part of a business that connects people across the globe and want to make a difference? Then waste no time and join our amazing team at DHL Group. DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) is the Group's air, ocean, and road freight specialist. We offer standardized transport as well as highly specialized end-to-end solutions to customers in a wide range of industries globally.
Who ever said ‘‘the sky is the limit’’ never spoke to you! Because for you it’s the beginning DHL Global Forwarding has an opening for Key Account Operations Specialist in Manama, Bahrain.

Key Account Operations specialist is responsible for the end to end operational management of assigned key accounts, ensuring shipments are executed accurately, proactively, and in line with agreed customer requirements. The role acts as the main operational contact between customers, internal teams, overseas offices, carriers, customs brokers, and other service providers. A key focus is to identify risks early, resolve exceptions quickly, maintain strong operational KPIs, and continuously improve service quality.
Join us in connecting people and improving lives!
In this Key Account Operations Specialist position
Manage day to day Airfreight shipments for assigned key accounts.
Coordinate bookings, documentation, customs clearance, transportation, and delivery activities.
Ensure shipments are executed according to customer SOPs, agreed routing, cut off times, and service requirements.
Maintain ownership of shipments from booking through final delivery and file closure.
Coordinate closely with overseas offices, gateways, carriers, and local operational teams.
Act as the primary operational contact for assigned customers.
Provide timely and accurate shipment status updates.
Proactively inform customers of delays, operational risks, or service disruptions.
Provide solutions and alternative routing options where required.
Maintain professional communication and build strong working relationships with customer operational teams.
Identify potential shipment issues before they become customer escalations.
Take immediate corrective action for delays, space constraints, documentation issues, customs problems, or delivery failures.
Escalate critical issues internally when additional support is required.
Perform root-cause analysis for recurring operational failures and implement preventive actions.
Monitor customer-specific and internal operational KPIs.
Monitor billing readiness, file completion, cost accuracy, and operational exceptions.
Review recurring service failures and develop improvement actions.
q: Min 3 years of experience in freight forwarding, logistics, or key account operations preferred.
Strong operational knowledge of Air Freight and/or Ocean Freight (preferably).
Experience handling strategic or demanding customer accounts.
Understanding of freight documentation, customs processes, carrier coordination, and shipment milestones.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Teams, and logistics/transport management systems.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
